headline: 97% of body burnt: Man sets himself on fire over divorce threat
summary: Shahadat Hossain, 32, is in critical condition at Dhaka Medical College Hospital after setting himself on fire in Old Dhaka.
details: Shahadat Hossain, a 32-year-old man, set himself on fire in the Posta area of Lalbagh, Old Dhaka, on Friday evening.

caption:
97% of his body is burnt. A man in Old Dhaka set himself on fire after his wife threatened him with divorce.

Shahadat Hossain, a 32-year-old man, set himself on fire in the Posta area of Lalbagh, Old Dhaka, on Friday evening.

He was admitted to the burn unit of Dhaka Medical College Hospital in critical condition, where doctors stated that 97% of his body has been burnt.

Shahadat told Prothom Alo that he lives at his in-laws' house in Lalbagh and set himself on fire due to anger over his wife, Jasmin Begum, wanting a divorce.

The victim further alleged that no one from his in-laws' house came forward to extinguish the fire after the incident occurred.

Two individuals rescued Shahadat and brought him to the hospital, but they left the premises after claiming they needed to buy medicine and did not return.

Inspector Mo. Habibur Rahman of the Dhaka Medical College Hospital Police Camp stated that the Chawkbazar Police Station has been informed to investigate the matter.
